answer:
I rebuilt the page on your Lisbon trip packing note for VoiceOver, and it can now add items. You'll find it under Page in the note. I haven't opened it in VoiceOver myself, so I haven't tested it with a screen reader.

- **Checking items:** Each item is a real checkbox with a label, so VoiceOver reads "Passport, checkbox, unchecked". The old page used plain boxes with no labels, which a screen reader couldn't announce. Ticked items also get strikethrough, so the state doesn't rely on colour alone.
- **Structure:** The title and each section (Clothes, Documents, Tech) are headings, so your partner can jump between them. Each heading also announces how many items in that section are packed.
- **Adding items:** There's a labelled "Item name" field, a "Section" picker and an "Add item" button. It's an "Add item" button with a text label, not the old icon-only button. Items go into the chosen section of the note's checklist.
- **Feedback:** Results are spoken aloud, for example "Passport packed" or "Sunscreen added to Clothes". Errors are announced the same way. Keyboard focus stays on the item or field you just used.
- **Visuals:** Controls are at least 44 px tall. The page uses the app's own colours, so dark mode works. It also has a visible focus outline.

The old page told you to ask Claude to add items. That message is gone.
